source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate leaves lobed or unlobed, to 20 cm; soft-pubescent beneath, sometimes sparse above; petioles generally 1 cm or longer (genus key)
morphology_documented.flowers: Unisexual catkin-like male and female inflorescences (genus)
morphology_documented.fruit: Edible mulberry multiple fruits usually red through dark purple (genus key)

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical source includes var. tomentosa within M. rubra
Compare with M. alba whose lower leaf blade is generally hairless except vein-axil tufts
Fruit color alone not reliable for mulberry ID
preservation: Additive file; existing species records, photographs, credits and galleries unchanged
